title.en: An Act Creating An Additional Legislative District in the Province of Cebu to Be Known as the Seventh Legislative District
title.orig: An Act Creating An Additional Legislative District in the Province of Cebu to Be Known as the Seventh Legislative District

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2015/ra_10684_2015.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Rules and Regulations. — The Commission on Elections shall issue the necessary rules and regulations within thirty (30) days upon approval of this Act.
Repealing Clause. — All laws, rules and regulations which are inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in any newspaper of general circulation.
